description: For plumbing call, this completion sign-off form records urgency, isolation, diagnosis, repair options, parts, code or permit needs, water-damage concern, and price approval. Its supporting evidence includes leak photos, pressure or flow readings, drain observation, removed-part condition, and post-repair test.

subtitle: Plumbing Call Completion Sign-Off Form: residential plumbing service call dispatch using fixture or piping, urgency, and leak photos.
title: Plumbing Call Completion Sign-Off Form
use_case: Use the completion sign-off form during residential plumbing service call dispatch when the plumbing call record must identify fixture or piping, leak location, shutoff access, water availability, affected rooms, occupancy, and prior repair. Complete the applicable handoff for leak-free test, restored fixtures, customer instructions, damage referral, permit follow-up, and service warranty.
